Requirements You are wielding a loaded firearm.

You launch yourself through the air with the kickback of a wielded firearm. You discharge your firearm, causing you to Leap up to 20 feet in any direction. At any point during the Leap, you can make a Strike with a weapon or unarmed attack you have, including a ranged Strike with the firearm you used for this feat if it ihas ammunition. You treat your fall at the end of the Leap as 20 feet lower.

If you spend 2 actions instead, you can Leap twice and treat your fall as 30 feet lower. You can make your Strike after either Leap.

If you spend a focus point when you use this constellation action, you Leap 30 feet with a single action, or 50 feet with two actions. You do not need to wield a loaded firearm or to discharge a firearm to do so.
